name: Library card (Kanopy, Hoopla)
license: Free with a library card (closed source)
summary: Many libraries let you stream movies and shows for free with Kanopy or Hoopla. Just use your library card.
gains: Great films, documentaries and kids content
tradeoffs: Monthly borrow limits set by your library
setupSteps: Get a free library card (often online)
Sign in to Kanopy or Hoopla with it
